description: Android activity class 'ContactAdder' for creating and managing contacts within an Android contact management app. Handles UI initialization, account management, and contact creation via ContentProvider operations.

classes.name: ContactAdder
classes.description: Main activity class for adding contacts, managing accounts, and UI interactions.

classes.name: AccountData
classes.description: Container class representing account information including name, type, label, and icon.

classes.name: AccountAdapter
classes.description: Custom ArrayAdapter for displaying account icons and labels in the account selection spinner.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, populates account and type spinners, and sets up listeners.

methods.name: onSaveButtonClicked
methods.description: Handles save button click, triggers contact creation, and finishes activity.

methods.name: createContactEntry
methods.description: Creates a new contact in the contacts provider based on UI input and selected account.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes account update listener when activity is destroyed.

methods.name: onAccountsUpdated
methods.description: Updates account list when system accounts change.

methods.name: getAuthenticatorDescription
methods.description: Retrieves AuthenticatorDescription for a given account type.

methods.name: updateAccountSelection
methods.description: Updates the selected account based on user selection.
